insight: Launched in 2019 as ByteDance's Gauthmath, a photo math solver; it hit #1 in US education app downloads in Q3 2025.
name: Gauth
tagline: AI study companion — snap a photo of any homework problem for step-by-step help.
description: A photo-based AI homework helper from ByteDance covering math, science, and humanities. Students photograph a problem and get step-by-step explanations, voice-based tutoring via the AI Live Tutor, and whiteboard-style walkthroughs, with live human tutors available as an escalation. Free to use with limits; a Gauth Plus subscription unlocks unlimited solutions and faster answers.
edge: Faster path from photo to worked solution than chat-first study aids, with a voice AI Live Tutor and whiteboard walkthroughs.

references.title: ByteDance's Gauth dominates 2025 US education charts
